sentences.text:
Shri C.M. Tiwari - Government Advocate
for State.
Heard on IA No.23377/2024, which is the first application for suspension of sentence and grant of bail moved on behalf of applicants.

The applicants have been convicted by the trial Court under Section 16(1)(a)(i) of Prevention of Food Adulteration Act and sentenced to undergo R.I. for six months (each) with fine of Rs.1000/-(each)
with default stipulations.
Aforesaid conviction and sentence has been affirmed by the appellate Court.

Learned counsel for the applicants have submitted that the Courts below have not properly appreciated the oral and documentary evidence available on record and committed error in convicting the applicants for aforesaid offence.
The sentence awarded to the applicants is 6 months.
Applicants have surrendered before the trial Court.
In this regard, he has filed order sheet of trial Court dated 30.09.2024.

There is a bleak possibility of disposal of this revision in near future,
therefore, the sentence of the applicants may be suspended and they may be released on bail.
Looking to the facts and circumstances of the case and period of sentence awarded to the applicant,
I find it to be a fit case to suspend the jail 2 CRR-4567-2024 sentence of the applicants and to release them on bail, therefore, without commenting on the merit of the case, this application is allowed.

It is directed that subject to depositing of the fine amount and on furnishing a personal bond in a sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand only) each with one surety each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court concerned, the remaining sentence of applicants shall remain suspended and they shall be released on bail for securing their presence before the trial Court concerned on 11.12.2024 and on such other dates as may be fixed in this regard during pendency of this case.
Record of the Courts below be requisitioned.
Certified copy as per rules.
